summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) pricing supplement for $400,000 of Senior Autocallable Notes due October 1, 2031, linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000 and EURO STOXX 50 indices. Priced September 29, 2026, issued September 30, 2026 at $1,000 per note, the notes pay an approximately 11.00% per annum call premium, are callable quarterly from September 2027, and are senior unsecured obligations under the Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
